salmanshh_pushoutsolid.name: Push-Out and Slide
salmanshh_pushoutsolid.description: Push an object out of registered solids after you move it: minimum push-out, wall sliding, sub-stepping for fast movement, and a nearest-open-space eject. You drive the movement, this corrects it.

resolutionMode.name: Resolution mode
resolutionMode.desc: How the object is pushed out of a wall. 'Minimum push' moves it the shortest way out (best for most games). 'Axis X only' and 'Axis Y only' push it out sideways or up and down only. 'Nearest open space' searches around for the closest free spot (slower; best used through the Eject action). 'Swept' traces the path from the object's last position to where you moved it and stops at the first wall, so a fast move (such as a mouse drag with Drag & Drop) cannot tunnel through or pop out the far side.

resolveOnTick.name: Resolve on tick
resolveOnTick.desc: When ticked, the object is automatically pushed out of walls every frame, right after your events move it. Untick it if you instead want to push out only at specific moments using the Resolve now action.

enableSliding.name: Enable sliding
enableSliding.desc: When ticked, an object pushed against a wall keeps the part of its motion that runs along the wall and glides along it - the same wall behaviour as the built-in 8-Direction behavior (moving or dragging diagonally into a wall slides along it instead of getting stuck). When unticked the object stops dead where it meets the wall and does not glide along it.

slideFriction.name: Slide friction
slideFriction.desc: How much the object is slowed as it slides along a wall while Enable sliding is on. 0% glides freely (like ice), higher values feel grippy or draggy, and 100% removes the glide so it effectively stops at the wall. Has no effect when Enable sliding is off, since the object stops dead there either way.

skinWidth.name: Skin width
skinWidth.desc: A tiny gap, in pixels, left between the object and the wall after a push. It stops the two from being counted as touching again next frame, which can otherwise cause a 1 pixel jitter. The default of 0.5 is invisible; raise it slightly if you still see jitter.

obstacles.name: Obstacles
obstacles.desc: Which objects count as walls. 'Custom' uses the object types you register with the Add solid action, so each object can have its own list. 'Solids' instead uses every object that has Construct's built-in Solid behavior, with no setup needed.

movementStyle.name: Movement style
movementStyle.desc: Declares the kind of game so contacts can be labelled. 'Top-down' treats every surface the same (no floor/wall/ceiling meaning) - ideal for top-down games. 'Side-scrolling' classifies each contact against the Up direction into floor, wall or ceiling, which powers the Is on floor / Is on wall / Is on ceiling conditions, the On landed / On hit wall / On hit ceiling triggers, slope readouts and jump-thru platforms.

jumpthruSource.name: Jump-thru
jumpthruSource.desc: Adds one-way platforms you can stand on from above but pass through from below or the side. 'None' disables them. 'Jump-thru behavior' uses every object carrying Construct's built-in Jump-thru behavior, with no setup. 'Custom' uses the object types you register with the Add jump-thru action. Needs an Up direction to know which way is 'down onto' the platform.

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Turn the whole behavior on or off. When off, the object is never pushed out of walls. You can change this while the game runs with the Set enabled action.

SetAxisResolution.description: Choose how overlaps are cleared. Minimum pushes along the single shortest direction (best for top-down). Separate clears the gravity axis before the cross axis, the stable land-then-touch-wall behaviour platformers expect.

mode.name: Mode
mode.desc: The axis resolution mode to use.

SetFloorSlopeMax.display-text: {my} Set max floor slope to {0} degrees
SetFloorSlopeMax.description: Set the steepest surface, in degrees from flat, still counted as a floor (or ceiling) rather than a wall. Also limits how far a jump-thru can tilt and still catch a landing. Clamped to 0-90.

degrees.name: Degrees
degrees.desc: The maximum floor slope in degrees (0 to 90).

SetJumpthruSource.description: Choose where one-way platforms come from. None disables them. Jump-thru behavior uses every object with the built-in Jump-thru behavior. Custom uses the types added with Add jump-thru.

SetMaxPushPerTick.display-text: {my} Set max push per tick to {0} px
SetMaxPushPerTick.description: Set the maximum length of a single correction, in pixels. Set to 0 for no limit.

pixels.name: Pixels
pixels.desc: The maximum length of a single correction, in pixels. 0 means no limit.

SetMovementStyle.description: Choose whether contacts are labelled. Top-down treats every surface the same; Side-scrolling classifies each contact against the Up direction into floor, wall or ceiling.

SetObstacles.description: Choose which objects count as walls: Custom uses the types added with Add solid, Solids uses every object with the built-in Solid behavior.

SetResolutionMode.description: Set how the push-out correction is computed.

SetSkinWidth.description: Set the gap kept between this object and solids after a push, in pixels.

pixels.name: Pixels
pixels.desc: The gap kept between this object and solids after a push, in pixels.

SetSlideFriction.description: Set the fraction of along-surface speed lost per resolution, from 0 (frictionless) to 1 (full stop). Values are clamped to that range.

friction.name: Friction
friction.desc: The friction fraction, from 0 (frictionless) to 1 (full stop).

SetSlidingEnabled.description: Set whether the object slides along solid surfaces instead of stopping at them.

SetStepDistance.description: Set the maximum distance moved per step, in pixels. Movement is broken into steps no larger than this. Set to 0 to disable stepping.

distance.name: Distance
distance.desc: The maximum distance per step, in pixels. 0 disables stepping.

SetUpDirection.description: Set which screen direction points away from gravity. Used in Side-scrolling style to tell a floor from a ceiling and to land objects on jump-thru platforms.

direction.name: Direction
direction.desc: The screen direction that points away from gravity.

AddJumpthru.description: Add an object type as a one-way platform for this object (used when Jump-thru source is Custom). The object can stand on instances of that type from above but pass through from below or the side.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object type to treat as a one-way platform.

ClearJumpthrus.description: Remove all object types from this object's jump-thru registry.

RemoveJumpthru.description: Stop treating an object type as a one-way platform for this object.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object type to stop treating as a one-way platform.

EjectToNearestOpenSpace.display-text: {my} Eject to nearest open space within {0} px
EjectToNearestOpenSpace.description: Search outward for the closest position where this object overlaps no solid, up to the given radius in pixels, and move it there. Triggers On ejected on success or On eject failed otherwise.

maxRadius.name: Max radius
maxRadius.desc: The maximum distance to search outward, in pixels.

ResolveNow.description: Run one resolution immediately, regardless of Resolve on tick. Triggers On pushed out if a correction is applied, or On became trapped if the object cannot be freed.

SetResolveOnTick.description: Set whether the object is corrected automatically every tick after movement. Turn it off to push out only when you call the Resolve now action (for example for detection-only or discrete corrections).

enabled.name: Enabled
enabled.desc: Whether to resolve automatically every tick.

AddSolid.description: Add an object type as a solid for this object. Instances of that type will push this object out. Adding the same type twice has no effect.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object type to treat as a solid.

ClearSolids.description: Remove all object types from this object's solid registry.

RemoveSolid.description: Stop treating an object type as a solid for this object.

object.name: Object
object.desc: The object type to stop treating as a solid.

IsJumpthru.description: True if the given object type is registered as a one-way platform for this object.

IsEnabled.description: True if the behavior is enabled.

IsOverlappingSolid.description: True if this object currently overlaps at least one registered solid.

IsSliding.description: True if the last resolution preserved along-surface movement.

IsTrapped.description: True if the last resolution left this object wedged against opposing solids.

OnBecameTrapped.description: Triggered when a resolution cannot free the object because it overlaps solids on opposing sides. OverlapCount reports how many solids it is wedged against.

OnEjected.description: Triggered after Eject to nearest open space succeeds. LastPushX and LastPushY give the offset from the original to the ejected position.

OnEjectFailed.description: Triggered when Eject to nearest open space finds no open position within the radius. The object is left at its original position.

OnPushedOut.description: Triggered after a resolution applies a non-zero correction. The LastPush, SurfaceNormal, Slide and OverlapCount expressions describe the correction just applied.

OnStep.description: Triggered for each step this object moves in, when stepping is enabled. Use it to make additional collision tests during fast movement. StepIndex and StepCount are available, and the object is at the current step's resolved position.

IsSolid.description: True if the given object type is registered as a solid for this object.

IsOnCeiling.description: True if the last resolution pushed the object off a ceiling (a surface facing against the Up direction). Only meaningful in Side-scrolling movement style.

IsOnFloor.description: True if the last resolution pushed the object off a floor (a surface facing the Up direction). Only meaningful in Side-scrolling movement style.

IsOnSlope.description: True if the object is on a floor that is tilted (not level) - i.e. on floor with a non-zero slope angle. Only meaningful in Side-scrolling movement style.

IsOnWall.description: True if the last resolution pushed the object off a wall (a surface too steep to be a floor or ceiling). Only meaningful in Side-scrolling movement style.

OnHitCeiling.description: Triggered on the resolution where the object first gains a ceiling contact (it bumped its head). Side-scrolling movement style only.

OnHitWall.description: Triggered on the resolution where the object first gains a wall contact. Read WallSide for which side the wall is on. Side-scrolling movement style only.

OnLanded.description: Triggered on the resolution where the object first gains a floor contact (it landed). Side-scrolling movement style only.

OnLeftFloor.description: Triggered on the resolution where the object loses its floor contact (it walked off an edge or was lifted away). Side-scrolling movement style only.

MovementStyle.description: The current movement style key (top_down or side_scroller).

ResolutionMode.description: The current resolution mode key (minimum_push, axis_x, axis_y, nearest_open or swept).

GetJumpthruByIndex.description: The name of the registered jump-thru object type at the given 0-based index.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The 0-based position in the jump-thru registry.

JumpthruCount.description: The number of object types currently registered as jump-thrus.

LastPushDistance.description: The length of the last correction, in pixels. 0 if the last resolution moved nothing.

LastPushX.description: The X distance of the last correction, in pixels.

LastPushY.description: The Y distance of the last correction, in pixels.

OverlapCount.description: The number of distinct solids the object overlapped at the last resolution.

SlideDistance.description: The length of the along-surface movement preserved at the last resolution, in pixels.

SlideX.description: The X distance of the along-surface movement preserved at the last resolution, in pixels. 0 if no sliding occurred.

SlideY.description: The Y distance of the along-surface movement preserved, in pixels.

StepCount.description: The number of steps the object moves in during the current tick. 1 when stepping is disabled.

StepIndex.description: The index of the current step, starting at 0. Meaningful inside On step.

SurfaceNormalX.description: The X component of the unit surface normal the object was pushed off (the push-out direction). 0 if nothing moved.

SurfaceNormalY.description: The Y component of the unit surface normal. Use with SurfaceNormalX to detect which side a wall is on.

GetSolidByIndex.description: The name of the registered solid object type at the given 0-based index.

index.name: Index
index.desc: The 0-based position in the solid registry.

SolidCount.description: The number of object types currently registered as solids.

FloorNormalX.description: The X component of the unit normal of the last floor contact (points away from the floor). 0 if no floor has been contacted.

FloorNormalY.description: The Y component of the unit normal of the last floor contact (points away from the floor). 0 if no floor has been contacted.

SlopeAngle.description: The signed angle of the current floor relative to level, in degrees. 0 on flat ground; positive when the floor tilts down toward the object's right. Meaningful while Is on floor is true.

TicksSinceFloor.description: How many resolutions have passed since the object was last on a floor. 0 while on the floor; grows once it leaves. Use it for coyote time (allow a jump for a few ticks after leaving a ledge). Only updates while Resolve on tick is on.

WallSide.description: Which side a contacted wall is on, relative to the Up direction: -1 wall on the object's left, +1 wall on its right, 0 if not on a wall.
